Let applicant- Sunil be released on bail in Case Crime No. 544 of 2021, under Sections 376, 498-A,
354-D, 323, 506 IPC, registered at P.S. Kankerkheda, District Meerut, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
